verdict.rationale: Chargebee's Dunning v2 schedules payment retries at set intervals alongside customer reminder emails. Its Smart retry logic adjusts retry timing to the type of gateway decline and treats hard and soft declines differently, so failed renewals are retried automatically on an optimized cadence. missing for 10: evidence of recovery metrics or reporting showing a measurable reduction in involuntary churn, explicit ML-based optimization (Smart retry is described as error-type driven), independent or hands-on corroboration.
